name: Spell Proc Item Enchant
description: Proc-per-minute rates for spells triggered by item enchantments (e.g. weapon enchant procs). The spell must be the first rank in its chain, the rate is propagated to higher ranks.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Enchantment proc spell, must be the first rank in its spell chain

fields.name: PPM Rate
fields.help: Procs per minute, scaled by weapon speed
